name: personal-assistant
description: Personal productivity skills. Includes open-items — reminders of Claude work started and not finished, kept as one file per project in a single tracker folder (~/Documents/Claude/Claude Task Tracker, overridable with CLAUDE_TASK_TRACKER), with categories inside each file. Three commands (log-item, end-of-session, open-items-status), a format validator, and a status listing so choosing where an item goes is picking from a list rather than remembering. Nothing observes whether work is finished; the user decides, and closing deletes the line.
